moodys.citation_text: Chapel Hill-based University of North Carolina Hospitals has an 'Aa3' rating and stable outlook with Moody's. Excellent market position and strong financial performance per Moody's profile.

sp.citation_text: UNC Health Care S&P rating at AA- per Becker's strong-finance compilations; no rating action found in window.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch AA- inferred from peer NC academic medical center ratings and absence of trade-press rating actions.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P downgraded UNC Health Southeastern (subsidiary) to BB; UNC Health Care main system unaffected
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Operating losses and sustained balance sheet weakness at UNC Health Southeastern specifically
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: UNC Southeastern, part of Chapel Hill, N.C.-based UNC Health system, saw its ratings on a series of bonds downgraded to 'BB' amid operating losses and sustained weakness in its balance sheet. Note: this action affected only the Southeastern subsidiary, NOT the main UNC Health Care credit.
rating_actions_in_window.verification_note: This rating action does NOT affect UNC Health Care main system rating; Southeastern is a separately-rated subsidiary.

moodys.citation_text: Aa3 stable maintained per Moody's profile.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch AA- maintained; no rating action found.

outcome_class_rationale: UNC Health Care (the main Chapel Hill-based system) carried Aa3/AA-/AA- (Moody's/S&P/Fitch) ratings throughout the window with stable outlooks. The UNC Southeastern subsidiary downgrade in June 2023 does NOT affect the main UNC Health Care credit rating per S&P's separate sub-credit assignment for Southeastern. No rating actions on the main UNC Health Care credit found in trade press for 2023-2025-Q1.

primary_sources_obtained: Moody's University of North Carolina Hospitals profile
